stages: 从 RGB-D 场景提出三维关键点，在图像上编号
Propose 3-D keypoints from the RGB-D scene and mark their IDs on the image
指令与标点图输入 VLM，生成各阶段的终点约束和路径约束
Condition the VLM on the instruction and marked image to write stage-end and path constraints
读取当前点位和机械臂状态，检查是否需回退阶段
Read current keypoints and arm state; backtrack a stage if a path constraint is violated
子目标求解器给出末端目标位姿，路径求解器给出到达它的运动
The subgoal solver chooses an end-effector pose; the path solver finds motions to reach it
执行路径的一小段，由底层控制器驱动机械臂
Execute a prefix of the path through the low-level arm controller
feedback: 动作后更新点位并重新求解，不是每次控制都重新询问 VLM。公开模拟器直接提供跟踪与碰撞几何，真机需另行感知。
After motion, update keypoints and solve again; no fresh VLM query is required at each control step. The public simulator supplies tracking and collision geometry that physical robots must estimate.
test: 表 1：七项任务各十次，自动约束成功 31/70，人工约束 48/70。表 2 的受扰三项任务不是同一个分母；自动方案成功 8/30。
Table 1: automatic constraints succeeded in 31/70 trials across seven tasks; human annotations in 48/70. Table 2 tests a different, disturbed three-task subset: 8/30 for automatic constraints.

stages: 读取当前相机图像与自然语言任务
Read the current camera image and natural-language instruction
融合 DINOv2 与 SigLIP 的图块特征，映射至文本嵌入空间
Concatenate DINOv2 and SigLIP patch features and project them into the language embedding space
Llama 2 以视觉与指令为条件，逐维自回归生成动作词元
Condition Llama 2 on vision and the instruction; autoregressively generate action-coordinate tokens
解码至区间中心，按目标数据集的分位数还原动作尺度
Decode to bin centers and restore action scale with target-dataset quantiles
机器人执行一次末端运动与夹爪指令，再读取新图像
Execute one end-effector and gripper command, then acquire the next image
feedback: 示范用于离线训练；Bridge 运行脚本在动作之间刷新观测。基础策略每次只看一张图，不预测未来图像，也不在线更新权重。

Demonstrations train the policy offline. The Bridge loop refreshes observations between actions; the base model takes a single image per query, does not predict future images and does not update weights online.
test: BridgeData V2 每策略 170 次，平均得分 70.6%，部分任务可获半分；RT-2-X 为 50.6%，但在语义泛化子集上更好。不能外推到任意新本体。

BridgeData V2: mean score 70.6% in 170 trials per policy, with partial credit on some tasks, versus 50.6% for RT-2-X. RT-2-X did better on the semantic subset; the result does not establish transfer to arbitrary new embodiments.
